simple.meaning: חָרַר (chârar) is a Hebrew word meaning “to glow , i.e. literally (to melt , burn , dry up) or figuratively (to show or incite passion ).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חָרַר (H2787) appears 11 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 30:30, with occurrences in Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Song of Solomon, Isaiah, and 2 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָרַר (H2787) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חָרַר (H2787) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חָרַר (chârar) / H2787 is traced through Job 30:30, Psalms 69:4, Psalms 102:4, Proverbs 26:21 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: My skin grows black and peels from me.

timeline.evidenceText: My skin grows black and peels from me.
Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head.
My heart is blighted like grass, and withered,
As coals are to hot embers,
Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.
The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not plucked away.
Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?
Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”
Then set it empty on its coals,

definitions.full: H2787. charar I. [ חָרַר ] verb be hot, scorched, burn poet . & late (Arabic be hot, burn, thirst ; Ethiopic Aramaic חַר ; compare Assyrian arâru , glow , SASm Assurbanipal i. p. 97 Belser BAS ii. 155 ) — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular חָ֫רָה Job 30:30 , וְחָ֫רָה consecutive Ezek 24:11 , חָ֫רוּ Isa 24:6 ; — 1 be hot, scorched , Jerusalem, under figure of caldron Ezek 24:11 . 2 burn = be burned , figurative of men, in ׳י s judgement, Isa 24:6 . 3 burn , of bones of sick men in fever ׳ח מִנִּיחֹֿרֶב Job 30:30 . Niph`al Perfect נָחַר Jer 6:29 , נָחָ֑ר Ezek 15:4 , נִחַר Psa 69:4 ; 3 plural נִחָ֑רוּ 102:4 (Kö i. 368 ); Imperfect וַיֵּחָ֑ר Ezek 15:5 יֵחָ֑רוּ 24:10 (strike out Co B and others) 1 be scorched , of bellows מַמֻּחַ in fierce fire Jer 6:29 **from √ נחר snort, puff , according to Mich Ew Gf Gie and others, — Du; (figurative); scorched, charred , of the vine (as fuel) Ezek 15:4-5 , middle part charred, the ends devoured ( אכל ) by fire (simile of inhabitants of Jerusalem); bones (simile id. ) 24:10 (see above). 2 burn , of bones in fever Psa 102:4 ( כְּמוֺקֵד , compare Qal Job 30:30 ); be parched , of throat ׳נח גרוני Job 69:4. — Isa 41:11 ; 45:24 ; Song 1:6 see חרה . Pilpel Infinitive לְחַרְחַררִֿיב Prov 26:21 to kindle strife .
